message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若想知道今天美國的黃金價格，建議您參考以下幾個可靠來源：

| 平台 | 連結 | 特色 |
|------|------|------|
| **Kitco** | https://www.kitco.com/ | 提供實時黃金、白銀等貴金屬價格與圖表 |
| **Bloomberg** | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets | 金融新聞、即時行情與分析 |
| **Reuters** | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities | 全球商品市場報價 |
| **Investing.com** | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold | 24/7 追蹤、歷史數據與技術分析 |
| **Yahoo Finance** | https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GC=F/ | 黃金期貨合約價格與新聞 |

在這些網站上，您可以查看「Gold Spot Price」或「Gold Futures」的即時報價，並且通常會顯示美元/盎司（USD/oz）的價格。若您需要更精確的數字（例如小數點後兩位），請直接進入上述任一平台的實時行情頁面。
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide current gold price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources. We can also provide typical price range. But we should not fabricate. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Suggest checking websites like Kitco, Bloomberg, etc.
